proposal.title: Gate historical call outcome experiments based on asset publication history
proposal.reason: When choosing an engagement strategy for newly selected market opportunities without prior publication history, candidate experiments like 'CREATOR CALL OUTCOME' (Experiment I) or 'FOLLOW-UP / UPDATE' (Experiment J) forced contextually incorrect framing claiming a previous call was being measured. Filtering eligible experiments based on whether the asset has historical coverage prevents hallucinated call outcome framing and improves editorial authenticity and reply rates.
